sentences.text: Shri Mohammad Ali, Senior Advocate with Shri Sharik Akeel   counsel for the applicant  Shri A. S. Baghel - Government Advocate for the respondent  ORDER

This is the SECOND application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nargik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 1446/2024 registered at Police Station Panagar, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 470 & 471 of IPC.

Earlier application being M.Cr.C. No.424/2026 was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 27.1.2026.
It is argued that the applicant is in custody since 28.11.2025.
The charge-sheet has already been filed in the matter.
He is a victim in the matter.
He has lost an amount of Rs.30 Lacs paid to two other co-accused persons.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he made all possible arrangements for getting the forged entry in the revenue records.
As the charge-sheet has been filed in the matter, there is no further requirement of custodial interrogation of the present applicant in the matter.
The applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:17697 2 MCRC-9625-2026 is the first offender.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the bail application.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail.

Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State vehemently opposed the application pointing out Mohammad Anwar Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131473223/

sentences.text: the fact that other three co-accused are still absconding in the matter.
The applicant in connivance with other accused persons have got entered their name in the revenue records and the sale deed was executed.
The complaint is made by the Tehsildar wherein name of the present applicant is clearly reflected, based upon the complaint, FIR has been registered against the applicant and others.
As per the case diary, the applicant is the first offender.
Under these circumstances, he has prayed for rejection of the bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as the fact that other co-accused are still absconding in the matter and there are specific allegations against the present applicant, no case for grant of bail is made out.
Accordingly, the bail application is hereby dismissed.

(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE JP Mohammad Anwar Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131473223/
